about.title: About MomiChan
about.subtitle: A fan-made home for moments shared by Momiyama Himeri and Takane no Nadeshiko.

origin.title: About Himeri
origin.himeriRomaji: 籾山ひめり / 籾山姫璃

profile.hobbies: Video editing, fashion, music, and café latte

origin.career: Momiyama Himeri is the captain of the Japanese idol group Takane no Nadeshiko. She began her idol career in 2014 as an early member of the local Tochigi idol group Watarase Bridge 43, later joined the roller-skating idol group Spindle, and became a member of Last Idol's Someday Somewhere unit in 2017. She joined Takane no Nadeshiko in 2022 and has served as captain since then.
origin.personality: Her public profile includes twin-tail styling, choreography work, and roller-skating performances. As a choreographer, she creates dances for her group and participates in roller-skating performances.
origin.platforms: She is active on TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube, sharing daily life, performances, and creative work with fans.
origin.purpose: MomiChan gathers these scattered moments into a fan album that is easy to revisit and share.

story.title: From the stage to today.
story.intro: A concise record of her groups, creative work, and public updates based on published profiles.
